Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: PRODUCTION seamless PBR steel surface detail texture, not a concept scene, not a photograph of an object.
Generate exactly ONE square image, 2048 x 2048 pixels, opaque.
Subject: an evenly framed orthographic planar field of dark forged steel surface. Tileable seamless material texture, left joins right and top joins bottom. No visible boundary, no center focus, no vignette, no exposure gradient.
Material: coarse but shallow black oxide islands over a neutral medium-dark graphite steel substrate; tiny impact scars, pitting and restrained fine physical grain. Dense material with varied roughness, NOT rock, charcoal chunks, asphalt, cracked mud, soil or lava. Oxide islands are flat exfoliating scales, with fine sharper edges, rather than lumpy 3D masses. Some scattered subtle thin linear working marks give steel identity. No decorative pattern or Damascus waves. All features are at one coherent material scale, suitable for repeating on a long 3D steel billet.
Critical imaging requirements: neutral grayscale only, no color cast, no orange rust, no red embers, no metallic specular highlights, no visible light source, absolutely no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion halos, no reflected environment, no directional shading, no glow. The image is a flat intrinsic surface-data map, NOT a beauty render. Pixel brightness records restrained surface variation and oxide coverage, never lighting. Mostly graphite gray rather than pure black, sufficient local tone range to read the micro-pits when used as a bump/roughness map.
No 3D object silhouette, no bevels, no blade, no handle, no floor, no room, no perspective, no caption, no labels, no text, no watermark, no UI, no frame.
Finish: expertly detailed physically believable forged metal information across the full canvas, subtle microstructure, production-quality PBR detail source, high definition, perfectly evenly exposed and seamlessly repeatable.
